title: Build Readonly & Partial
hints: Both are mapped types: `{ [K in keyof T]: T[K] }` copies every property of `T` unchanged. Start from that.
Modifiers go around the key: `readonly` in front of the bracket, `?` after it.
type MyReadonly<T> = { readonly [K in keyof T]: T[K] };  and  type MyPartial<T> = { [K in keyof T]?: T[K] };
